title: Scheduler commands queued at shutdown are leaked
summary: agent_change_property() queues a scheduler_command with a property copy; indigo_cancel_pending_handlers() in detach drops queued handlers without freeing their data. Only commands arriving in the last moment before unload leak. Next: track queued commands or drain them in detach.

resolution.evidence: Task 20261113001457-32cc-scheduler-shutdown-command-leak: queued commands are kept in a list under a mutex and released by stop_commands() at shutdown, new requests are ignored while shutting down; regression case commands_queued_at_shutdown_are_released with an explicit leak check fails against the old agent (76-426 leaked commands per run) and passes after the fix, see verification.md.
